scope: The standing 1858 Theatro São Pedro at Praça Marechal Deodoro in Porto Alegre, including the colonnaded entrance, balcony, main theatre and rear stage range.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The theatre describes the seven-bay front, light-colored walls, two upper flanking windows on each side, three upper doors, balustraded terrace, bronze name and three central steps.
The UFRGS architecture study identifies original building mass, side recess, classical trim on upper windows and a roof hidden behind the modest side parapet.
Published architecture research corroborates Luigi Terragno’s circa-1875 photograph as an original theatre record and documents the bracketed cornice and three round portico arches.
The Brazilian National Library identifies the named photographer and documents his death on 16 September 1891.
